PNC Park is an intimate, classic-style ballpark that embraces the
progressiveness of Pittsburgh while saluting the spirit of early ballpark
originals. Its scenic vistas of downtown and the riverfront create an exciting
and dramatic urban sports venue.

For over 25 years, the Allegheny Regional Asset District (RAD) has invested in
Allegheny County’s quality of life through financial support of public
libraries, parks & trails, regional attractions, arts & cultural
organizations, sports & civic facilities, public transit, and local municipal
services with revenue from an additional, countywide one percent sales and use
tax. Since its inception, RAD has resulted in over $4 billion invested in the
region. Visit radworkshere.org for more information.

The Pirates Main Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 a.m. to
5:00 p.m. (or 15 minutes after game ends on gameday). On gameday Saturdays and
Sundays, the Pirates Main Ticket Office will open at 9 a.m. and close 15
minutes after the game ends.
